en.about.title: About Tickerfish
en.about.data_notes.line1: • Updates: US Stocks every {interval} — not real-time
en.about.data_notes.line2: • Free-tier APIs often delay stock data 15–20 minutes
en.about.data_notes.line3: • Numbers may differ between providers; official exchanges are authoritative
en.about.data_notes.line4: • When markets are closed, the last close price is shown
en.about.data_notes.line5: • Pre-market and after-hours trades are not shown — after the 4:00 PM ET close, the regular-session close price is used
en.about.data_notes.line6: • Market hours use US Eastern Time and auto-follow US daylight saving (EDT/EST), regardless of your local time zone
en.about.data_notes.line7: • Crypto prices come from Binance (24/7); no API key required
en.about.disclaimer: Entertainment-only visualization. Not investment advice. Author is not liable for any losses. Invest carefully.
en.about.privacy: 🔒 API keys and game data stay only on your computer — nothing is uploaded to any server. If you notice unusual usage on a key, regenerate it on the provider's website and update it in the in-game settings.
en.price_rec.title: Price Recording
en.price_rec.no_tickers: No stocks in your watchlist yet.
en.price_rec.note: Records during market hours only, in US Eastern Time. Saved to price_history_<year>.csv in the data folder. Turning off leaves gaps; past data can't be recovered.
en.price_rec.prompt_body: Record price history to a CSV file you can analyze in Excel? When on, prices are saved every so often during market hours. Recording starts from now — it can't fill in the past. You can change this anytime in Price recording settings.

en.guide.title: How to get an API Key
en.guide.intro: Tickerfish uses Finnhub's free API for US stock data. Sign up and paste your key in settings.
en.guide.tip: 🔒 Your API Key stays on your machine.
en.guide.finnhub.notes: Recommended. Copy the API Key from the top box on the Dashboard (not Webhook or Security).

en.guide.step1: 1. Open the sign-up page and register with your email.
en.guide.step2: 2. Confirm the verification email Finnhub sends you.
en.guide.step3: 3. Sign in — you land on the Dashboard.
en.guide.step4: 4. Copy the API Key from the box at the top of the Dashboard (not Webhook, not Security).
en.guide.step5: 5. Come back here, paste it in settings and hit Save.
en.guide.crypto_note: Crypto (BTC, ETH...) needs no key — it works without this.

zh.about.title: 关于看盘鱼
zh.about.data_notes.line1: • 美股数据每 {interval} 更新一次,非实时

zh.about.data_notes.line4: • 闭市期间显示最近一次收盘价
zh.about.data_notes.line5: • 不显示盘前/盘后成交 —— 美东 4:00 PM 收盘后,显示正常交易时段的收盘价
zh.about.data_notes.line6: • 开收盘按美东时间(ET)判定,自动跟随美国夏令时切换(EDT/EST),与你本地时区无关
zh.about.data_notes.line7: • 加密货币价格来自 Binance(全天候 24 小时),无需 API 密钥
zh.about.disclaimer: 本软件仅供娱乐与可视化用途,不构成投资建议。作者不对任何因使用本软件导致的损失负责。投资请谨慎。
